entry_points.text: Locking selftest runs deadlock, safety, wait, local, naming suites classifying failures and restoring state; port families use direct, indirect or drop by token; queue exercise checks single, bulk, filter, drain; soft safe, hard deadlocks.
Cyclic alloc uses hint with wrap and retry; empty searches validate and position or report invalid, present, busy; store family validates locking with demand; debug start past end errors.
Forward and backward iteration under read-side with validation; bounded find leaves active; pause preserves position; reclaimed nodes reset or rewalk.

Lookup under read-side with zero handling; single ops delegate to range; alloc finds, inserts, reports start repeating after pressure; erase traces; dup unlocked or nested; search advances past end; full range is max ulong with invalid and no-memory mappings.

Boot makes aligned node cache reserve 32 panicking on fail with no-fail mode; tuning forwards marking, callback, private, size, counts; dump reports tree rendering layouts deriving intervals, stopping at empties, erroring past max.

exports.text: Fused lock and count offers unconditional, positive and non-negative gated acquire, release with survivors, final release keeping lock, and dead mark, trying atomic update before locked path.

IO memory registers regions then serves sized read, write, fill and copy via area methods bulk-first with warning fallbacks; port IO manages firmware ranges translating hardware, CPU and token forms with sentinel on miss.
LRU cache from caller slab offers strict, cumulative and non-creating gets with release, delete, indexed access and diagnostics; plus 64-bit half shift and FIFO single and bulk dequeue via reversal.
Maple encoders and full-state helpers; forward and reverse searches use slot advance with stale retry; erase stores null returning prior; two atomics count test runs and passes.

hazards.text: Two early local cycles must pass while later spin cycle under irq must fail; postorder rewinds on overflow losing offsets; two pointer formats with function trace.
External lock, RCU, list, slab, diagnostic, thread, barrier, atomic, error, resource, lockdep, container, alloc-check, queue helpers owned elsewhere.

invariants.text: Most outers allow read-side, raw spin and spin but forbid mutex; restrictive outers allow only read-side and raw spin; mutex allows all; guards nest outer-inner reversing release across three preemption classes.
Fast path reads eight-byte unit once, proceeds only while unlocked, mutates copy, tries wide exchange, retries to bound then uses locked revalidating path; alternate build always locks.
Subclass change keeps semaphore name, null when untracked; one unit defines log prefix and IO-range mutex.
Registration needs identity, nonzero extent and ops for indirect, rejects duplicates and overlaps, enforces bounds with shrink fallback and distinct failures.
Lookup hashes pending number modulo capacity hiding uncommitted optionally; gets respect starving, locked, dirty, pending limits and victim availability.
Reserved combines bound with internal-pointer test; full-null is bit mask; pivots write only to 64-bit range nodes in bound.
Descent uses first covering pivot or dense arithmetic; suitability from totals or clipped vacancy; insert needs vacancy; siblings fail at edges; empty trees answer directly.
Dup needs same attrs and empty dest; pointer and empty publish directly; others copy depth-first rewiring parents then publish; shrink is no-op or forward.
Range insert rejects coded values and inverted intervals, retries on pressure, maps errors and frees temporaries.

locks.text: Global mutex guards region list only between reservation and linking.
Range mutations use mutex, lookups use read-side with deferred free; descriptor has identity, bases, extent, flags, ops with context and linkage.
Mutations assert exclusivity via entry-set flag cleared on exit; nonblocking attempt retries only while held.
Tree iteration uses read-side with protected dead links; must-succeed needs lock and restores interval; partial trees free leaf-upward.

state_machines.text: Elements cycle free, evictable, in-use, pending with refcount and commit promotion; misuse aborts while undersize, oversize or alloc failure yields null.
Reverse setup normalizes against lower bound across phases, handling pointer, empty and bound cases before arming stepping.

structs.text: Region has resource, ops and list; area has ops and private in table; selector high with 24-bit offset, 16MB each, 128 areas; biases DEAD000000000000,80000000 with masks FFFFFFFF00000000,80000000; unmapped reads all-ones, writes no-op warning.
Element has index, numbers, refcount, linkages; cache has name, sizing, counters, flags, lists, vector, slots; test record has linkage, id, counter.
Root tag 0x02, shift 0x03, null 0x04, parent 1, prealloc 1; per-type key, slot, pivot, minima tables; parent root 0x01, shifts 0x03,0x02 with masks 0xF8,0xFC, range tags 0x06,0x02.
Cursor holds interval, window, node, slot, status, intent, demand; nodes have pivot, slot, gap vectors with masked parent; slots via type tables; gaps recomputed with dense, index, parent checks.
